description: Initial thresholds for the RTGI quality harness. They are intentionally broad until per-GPU baseline captures are recorded and reviewed.

stress._note: The dark-firefly cap covers the dark-region count on the full path tracer path: its 1-spp primary-direct next-event estimate leaves a few dark fireflies in the genuinely dark ROI, where the Hybrid path reads 0 with wide margin. The cap is set to the measured full-path-tracer worst-case plus a small pixel-count margin, re-recorded after the ray tracing frame index was changed to advance once per rendered frame (the low-resolution jitter sequence went from period 4 to period 16, which shifts the dark-ROI firefly count by one pixel).

cornell_box._note: The generic firefly/speckle thresholds are calibrated to the cornell_box content. The shared dark-region ROI is tuned for the stress scene's genuinely dark area; in the lit Cornell interior (dark_roi_mean_luma ~0.30) it counts normal lit-surface detail, so these caps sit above the measured stable values. The meaningful cornell_box quality gates are the wall and floor color-bleed margins and the ceiling hot-pixel count.

specular_motion._note: Generic firefly and speckle caps are calibrated to the worst orbit phase of this moving-light specular stressor. They are regression baselines, not absolute targets; the moving highlights drive frame-to-frame variance by design. The temporal_sparkle cap is set for the canonical pinned-120 --rtgi-modes=fpt,hybrid run: the in-process fpt-then-hybrid switch lands the hybrid pass at a higher sparkle attractor than either single-mode run (the fpt pass primes the shared temporal state), and after the blue-noise and reservoir-reuse changes that pinned value measured 424.4/Mpx, so the cap sits at that value plus headroom rather than the earlier single-mode 320. This lets the one canonical multi-mode invocation gate green under the pinned protocol.

reflective_pool._note: FPT-fast scene (rtgi_mode=1). The reflection edge energy is phase-dependent (the colored lamp highlights orbit and bob), so the floor is set to the lower phase value with margin; it is a regression baseline, not an absolute target. reflective_pool_reflection_coverage is the mirror-reflection sentinel: the no-reflection state reads ~0.12 (diffuse bounce light only) and the working mirror reads ~1.0, so the 0.5 floor catches a reflection regression with wide margin.

fog_corridor._note: Fog parity is gated by the FOGPAR verdict line the scene's metric script prints (PASS needs max_rel_err <= 0.10 against the --rtgi-mode=off raster reference). No JSON thresholds: the comparison spans multiple runs sharing one output dir, so a single-run threshold gate cannot express it.

light_grid._note: Many-light reservoir stressor (24 shadowed omnis, camera orbit + moving emissive + one scripted light toggle), gated against the post-reuse balanced=8 baseline. The wired metrics are regression sentinels, not absolute targets: light_grid_orbit_delta_avg is the spurious-reset sentinel (a reintroduced per-frame history reset raises the orbit-phase whole-image delta), light_grid_static_tail_delta is the reuse-alive sentinel (if temporal reuse breaks, the frozen post-toggle floor climbs back toward the per-frame-noise level a raster run reads as 0.0), light_grid_toggle_far_rect_delta catches a wrongly-global reset on the toggle (the far corner did not change), and light_grid_toggle_recovery_frames bounds how long the toggle transient takes to decay to the static floor. temporal_sparkle and orbit_sparkle caps catch a sparkle storm while tolerating the single-pixel quantum (7.716/Mpx at this resolution). light_grid_toggle_spike and local_rect stay report-only (a real local response to the toggle, expected to vary). The firefly caps stay generous: this scene must never produce fireflies.

light_toggle._note: Diffuse reconvergence + indirect-occlusion scene: one bright key light, a thin static occluder on the floor, and the indirect-only floor strip in the occluder umbra. The harness flips the key light off (held 45 frames so the RTGI history fully decays), then on, and measures the umbra-indirect rebuild. The metrics are regression sentinels, not absolute targets, gated against the pinned-120 --rtgi-modes=fpt,hybrid baseline (fpt is the worse case for both luma metrics). light_toggle_convergence_frames is the recovery sentinel: this fork's diffuse resolve re-lights the umbra in a single frame, so a healthy binary reads 0; the max-8 cap (matching light_grid_toggle_recovery_frames) catches a regression that stalls the rebuild for several frames. light_toggle_leak_luma is the occlusion-leak sentinel (mean LINEAR luma of the umbra ROI, indirect-only with the key light on): fpt 0.0895, hybrid 0.0688; the max cap sits at the fpt value plus ~28% so a leak that brightens the shadowed strip trips it. light_toggle_contact_sharpness is the contact-occlusion sentinel (mean vertical luma gradient across the dark line at the occluder base): fpt 0.00486, hybrid 0.00501; the min cap sits at the lower value times 0.75 so a washed-out, leaked contact trips it. The firefly caps stay generous: the only noise is the traced contact shadow, which must not produce fireflies.

wall_leak._note: Sealed thin-wall light-leak probe. A box open at the top is split on the x = 0 plane by a thin full-height opaque divider into a lit half (a bright omni inside it) and a sealed dark half (no light, no opening except through the divider). A straight-down camera frames both chamber floors side by side. wall_leak_luma is the mean LINEAR luma of the dark-half floor ROI just past the divider, which has no legitimate light path and should read near zero; wall_lit_luma is the matching lit-half ROI as the context reference. The leak reads as the fraction wall_leak_luma / wall_lit_luma. Measured on this binary (pinned-120 --rtgi-modes=fpt,hybrid): wall_lit_luma fpt 0.956, hybrid 0.939; wall_leak_luma fpt 0.00160, hybrid 0.00183; leak fraction 0.17 percent (fpt) and 0.19 percent (hybrid), i.e. effectively no through-wall leak. max_wall_leak_luma sits at 0.006, about 3.3x the worst measured value and 0.6 percent of the lit reference, so a leak that brightens the sealed dark floor to even 1 percent of the lit floor trips it while the current leak-free binary gates green. The firefly caps stay generous: the only thing in frame is two flat Lambert floors, which must not produce fireflies.

motion_ghost._note: Continuous-motion temporal-trail probe for the diffuse screen-probe-gather (SPG). A bright compact omni orbits a circle on a large neutral floor under a static straight-down camera, so the only thing moving on screen is the lit pool, isolating the diffuse SPG indirect path. motion_ghost_luma is the residual LINEAR luma (above the static-background floor) at a floor point the orbiting pool covered 50 frames ago but has since orbited about 4.4 m past, well outside its roughly 2.65 m direct pool, so any luma there is indirect/temporal trail. motion_ghost_current_luma is the live pool ROI as the context reference and motion_ghost_static_luma is a fixed far-corner ROI the pool never reaches. The trail reads as the ratio motion_ghost_luma / (current - static). Measured on this binary (pinned-120 --rtgi-modes=fpt,hybrid): current pool fpt 0.456, hybrid 0.452; static background about 0.00002; motion_ghost_luma fpt 0.00413, hybrid 0.00487; ghost ratio 0.91 percent (fpt) and 1.08 percent (hybrid), i.e. a faint indirect trail about 200x the static floor but only about 1 percent of the live pool. max_motion_ghost_luma sits at 0.012, about 2.5x the worst measured value and about 2.6 percent of the live pool, so a doubling of the trail trips it while the current binary gates green. The sparkle cap admits the moving pool edge (about 15.4/Mpx measured) and the firefly caps stay generous (a single moving light on a flat floor must not produce fireflies).

sun_penumbra_ramp._note: Soft contact-shadow characterization scene (a low, large-disc sun behind a thin wall, casting a long penumbra across a neutral floor). It pins its own short canonical settle of 16 frames: the structural edge width (sun_penumbra_width_px) is settled there (raster reads 29 columns, the ray-traced pass reads about 38), while sun_penumbra_band_hf (the mean per-column vertical scatter of the soft shadow edge, the within-column per-sample shadow noise) captures the residual shadow noise at that settle. width_px and band_hf now gate: max_sun_penumbra_width_px 40 admits both the raster 29 and the ray-traced edge with headroom, and max_sun_penumbra_band_hf 0.072 sits above the raster reference band noise (about 0.065, the same cap applies to the off mode) and well below the one-sample ray-traced baseline (about 0.080), so the gate admits the raster path and the multi-sampled ray-traced path while still catching a regression back to a single shadow sample. The solid-angle-scaled multi-sample shadow drops the ray-traced band_hf from about 0.080 (one sample) to about 0.047 (balanced preset, two samples). lit_luma and occluded_luma stay report-only (generous caps) since their absolute level is not a quality gate.

area_light_wall._note: Solid-color area-light isolation scene. area_wall_pool_mean_luma is the energy-parity and double-count sentinel, gated as a band around the raster reference (off about 0.769, ray-traced LTC about 0.777, plus or minus ten percent): the min catches a too-dim regression (the earlier single-sample estimate read about 0.61) and the max catches a double-count (an area light summed both in the deterministic area pass and through the reservoir roughly doubles it). area_wall_atten_edge_hf is now gated: the shared-sample shadow ratio (warm fpt 0.000427) replaces the single shadow ray (was 0.000546, a 22 percent noise increase); gate is warm value times 1.25 = 0.000534, catching any regression back toward single-ray noise levels.

textured_area._note: Textured area-light mip-accuracy scene. area_textured_mean_luma is the energy-parity key, gated as a band around the raster reference (off about 0.298, ray-traced LTC about 0.303), plus or minus ten percent. area_textured_structure_stddev measures projected-texture structure retention: the always-coarsest-mip path collapses it toward zero (the earlier path read about 0.12), the solid-angle-adaptive mip restores it toward the raster reference (off about 0.265, ray-traced about 0.270); the min gate proves structure is present, the max stays generous. Read structure only after energy parity holds: the stddev is brightness-confounded, but at matched mean the coefficient of variation (stddev over mean) of the ray-traced pass tracks the raster within a fraction of a percent.

hybrid_mirror._note: Hybrid sharp-reflection sentinel: a near-mirror surface (metallic=1.0, roughness=0.05) under rtgi_mode=2 (Hybrid) with three floating emissive spheres. hybrid_mirror_reflection_coverage, the fraction of the pool ROI above 0.15 luma, is the headline metric. Under Hybrid the surface traces a sharp ray-traced reflection of the scene, so the pool fills with the reflected emitters (about 0.99 coverage); the fpt-reference oracle is the ground-truth reference (about 0.91). The 0.35 coverage floor guards the sharp-reflection channel against regressing to the raster-only level (about 0.10, which is just diffuse bounce and direct highlights with no traced reflection). edge_energy and surface_mean_luma floors are near-zero regression baselines. The firefly cap is generous because the fpt-reference oracle path tracer is still noisy at the 120-frame settle.

hybrid_rough_metal._note: Hybrid rough-metal guard: a wall with metallic=0.31 / roughness=0.77 under rtgi_mode=2 (Hybrid), bright sky (background_energy_multiplier=3.0). The roughness is above the 0.35 sharp band, so Hybrid leaves this surface's raster environment specular and the probe rough-spec untouched (the sharp-band suppression weight is exactly 1.0 here). hybrid_rough_metal_wall_luma is the mean linear luma of the metal wall ROI; the fpt-reference oracle measures about 0.85 and Hybrid about 0.77. The band brackets that level so the rough band cannot regress to dim or blow out, which is the guard that the sharp-band suppression never reaches a rough surface. The firefly cap is generous for the noisy oracle at the 120-frame settle.
